axes.model_access: Self-developed "Tiangong" model line (filing no. Beijing-TianGong-20231016, CAC April-2024 filing-summary attachment, direct-fetched and verified); the product now positions itself as a "super agent" (official-site title narrative) — search + docs/PPT/sheets/webpage multi-mode generation.
axes.runtime: Web (tiangong.cn) + App (seen on the official site); retrieval and generation on the vendor's cloud; direct connection from mainland China works.
axes.local_files: Generated docs/PPTs/sheets and history stored on the account-side cloud; downloads count as local. No other local data surfaces officially stated seen.
axes.background: Search is instant; the docs/PPT/sheets/webpage modes are generation task lines (official product surface); no "keep-running-after-shutdown" concept.
axes.tools: AI search (the founding feature) + super-agent multi-modes (rapid/docs/PPT/sheets/webpage, official product surface), "make the same kind" (template-reuse line, seen on the official site); Kunlun Tech's product lines are many (Skywork open-model line/Mureka music etc. — outside this dossier's scope).
axes.context: Agent artifacts organized by task/history; the "memory" feature copy seen via in-site direct fetch (the product boundary of cross-session memory not verified item by item).
axes.permissions: Account + subscription system (D9: pricing not collected); the training-use switch not verified item by item. Filing: Tiangong model filing no. Beijing-TianGong-20231016 (CAC batch summary-table mirror, direct-fetched 2026-10-22); the algorithm filing "天工大语言模型算法" covers Tiangong AI Search across surfaces (public-registry narrative).
axes.fit: Fits: Chinese search + office artifacts one-stop (PPT/sheets/docs generated directly), mainland direct connection, template-reuse workflows. Does not fit: English-leaning retrieval first, treating generated artifacts as review-free finished products (PPTs/sheets need human review).
